{"metadata":{"description":"DSH plugin: OpenCode Go 套餐用量显示（滚动/每周/每月用量百分比与重置倒计时 + Agent 工具 opencode_go_usage）。官方 bundle 插件，安装: dsh plugin --profile web add github:vinyumao/dsh-opencode-usage#<ref>","id":"gh:1334383443","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-opencode-usage","slug":"vinyumao/dsh-opencode-usage","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-bundle","dsh-plugin","quota","tool","ui","usage"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH plugin: OpenCode Go 套餐用量显示（滚动/每周/每月用量百分比与重置倒计时 + Agent 工具 opencode_go_usage）。官方 bundle 插件，安装: ds"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"h plugin --profile web add github:vinyumao/dsh-opencode-usage#<ref>"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"dsh-opencode-usage"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"OpenCode Go plan usage display for the DSH web GUI — a persistent badge under the composer shows rol"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ling / weekly / monthly usage percents and reset countdowns; click to expand a card; agents can quer"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"y the balance via the opencode_go_usage tool."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Official DSH bundle plugin. Install with one command:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Capability surface"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Tool | Description |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| `opencode_go_usage` | Query OpenCode Go plan balance in chat: used percent + reset countdown for t"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"he three windows (no arguments) |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| UI capability | Description |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Persistent badge | One line under the composer input: `OpenCode Go：滚动用量 0% · 每周用量 0% · 每月用量 0%`, a"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"uto-refreshing on a configurable interval |
| Usage card | Click the badge to expand: progress bars "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"for the three windows + used percent + per-second reset countdown + instant refresh + an `opencode` "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"link that opens the web usage dashboard in a new tab |
| Config form | Fill in API key / Base URL / "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"refresh interval / web usage URL right in the card; saved immediately |
| Bilingual UI | 中文 / Englis"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"h — every string follows the global DSH locale (Settings → General → Language), and the card footer "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"has a built-in 中文 / English toggle that switches the whole GUI |
| Key reuse | API key defaults to t"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"he `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` environment variable — the same one the DSH opencode-go model provider conf"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ig uses (`apiKeyEnv` in `settings.yaml`), so it usually works with **zero configuration** |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Usage comes from the OpenCode Go subscription quota endpoint:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Example response:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> ⚠️ **Unverified**: this endpoint is **not part of the official public documentation** — it was sur"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"faced by the cc-switch community (issue includes a verification script). The response shape may chan"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ge as opencode evolves; this plugin parses defensively (both `usage.`-prefixed and bare windows, bot"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"h `resetsAt` and numeric `resetsInSeconds` forms), so please defer to the live response if the struc"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"and numeric `resetsInSeconds` forms), so please defer to the live response if the structure changes."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The browser never talks to the upstream directly: every request goes through the host process's `/ap"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"i/dsh-opencode-usage/*` routes (same-origin fetch), so **the API key never enters the browser**."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### About OpenCode Zen"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"This plugin is **Go-plan specific** — it shows the subscription quota windows, which only exist for "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"OpenCode Go. OpenCode Zen is a separate **pay-as-you-go** gateway (prepaid balance, per-token billin"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"g) and has **no equivalent API-key-authenticated balance endpoint**: the official feature request (a"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"nomalyco/opencode#10448, "Add Zen balance API endpoint") is still open, and community tools that sho"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"w Zen balances rely on brittle browser-cookie scraping of the workspace billing page (e.g. CodexBar)"},{"id":"p20s6","text":". If a public Zen balance API ships, this plugin can add a `plan` option to consume it."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> **Zero runtime SDK imports**: the host half imports **no `@deepseek-ai/*` packages at runtime** — "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"the agent tool is written in the raw registrable shape `ctx.tools.register` accepts (standard JSON S"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"chema in `output.schema`, plain `render`/`execute`), instead of being built with `defineTool` from `"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`. That is what makes a git vendoring install (`dsh plugin add github:...`, wh"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ich clones into a workspace `vendor/` dir) work out of the box: Node never has to resolve `@deepseek"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"-ai/*` from the plugin's own `node_modules`, because the plugin never imports them. (Earlier revisio"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"ns imported `defineTool`; if you hit `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, update to "},{"id":"p22s8","text":"ineTool`; if you hit `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, update to the latest ref.)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Method 1: one `dsh plugin` command (recommended)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"From anywhere:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the install automatically joins the profile's `dsh.pr"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ofile.bundles` layer stack and mounts `cordis.patch.yml`. Then **restart `dsh web`** — the badge app"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ears under the composer."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"> A git install fetches source; this plugin is pure source (`index.mjs` / `client.js`, no build step"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"), so it works right away with no `prepare` script. If pnpm asks for an `allowBuilds` permission, co"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"py the package key it prints into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and retry. For reproducible in"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"stalls, pin `<ref>` to a commit SHA (`#<sha>`)."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Method 2: manual wiring"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"1. Add to the profile's `package.json` `dependencies`:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"2. Run `pnpm install` in the profile directory.
3. Confirm `dsh.profile.bundles` contains the packag"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"e (`dsh plugin` reconciles automatically); or add to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"4. **Restart `dsh web`** — the badge appears under the composer."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"### Installation guide for AI agents"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"When an AI assistant installs this on the user's behalf, follow these steps:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- `/api/dsh-opencode-usage/*` is loopback-only (with same-origin checks); a LAN-exposed deployment c"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"annot leak the proxied key.
- The API key is stored in plaintext at `~/.dsh/dsh-opencode-usage.json`"},{"id":"p38s3","text":" (0600) — the same trust model as the dsh-ssh credential store.
- The config read endpoint only retu"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"rns `hasApiKey` / `apiKeySource`; the key itself never leaves the host."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"- The badge hangs in the composer dock (visible when a session is open); it is hidden when no sessio"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"n is active.
- The usage endpoint is not officially documented; the shape may change (see "How it wo"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"rks").
- The config form's key input is "append/overwrite" semantics: saving with an empty key keeps"},{"id":"p40s4","text":" the current key; to fall back to the environment variable, edit the config file and remove the `api"},{"id":"p40s5","text":"t key; to fall back to the environment variable, edit the config file and remove the `apiKey` field."}],"truncated":true}
